title: 2024 AMC 8 Problem 24
statement: Jean made a piece of stained glass art in the shape of two mountains, as shown in the figure below. One mountain peak is \(8\) feet high and the other peak is \(12\) feet high. Each peak forms a \(90^\circ\) angle, and the straight sides of the mountains form \(45^\circ\) angles with the ground. The artwork has an area of \(183\) square feet. The sides of the mountains meet at an intersection point near the center of the artwork, \(h\) feet above the ground. What is the value of \(h?\)

solutions.text:
Each mountain is a \(45^\circ\text{-}45^\circ\text{-}90^\circ\) triangle. A right isosceles triangle with height \(x\) has area \(x^2\), since its two perpendicular sides each have length \(x\sqrt2\).

The two large mountains have areas \(8^2=64\) and \(12^2=144\). Their overlap is also a \(45^\circ\text{-}45^\circ\text{-}90^\circ\) triangle with height \(h\), so its area is \(h^2\). Thus \[ 64+144-h^2=183, \] so \(h^2=25\), and \(h=5\).

Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: Each mountain is built from a \(45^\circ\)-\(45^\circ\)-\(90^\circ\) triangle
Add the two large triangle areas and subtract the overlap
